dimensions.evidenceA: No sandals are listed among what is acquired.
dimensions.label: Sandals

evidence.observation: Take no bag for the journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff.
The Twelve are told to take nothing except a staff and to wear sandals.

record.tension: The mission instructions prohibit and permit a staff in the two accounts.
record.title: May the Twelve take a staff?
